text:
anya: Found a CI build cache tarball in gs://build-cache-uploads/2026-09-12/runner-7/cache-2026-09-12.tar.gz that contains a VAULT_TOKEN and a long-lived service account JSON. Marking P0 for immediate rotation. :rotating_light:

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-912 created and oncall paged.

priya: Can you paste a masked grep snippet so we can scope quickly (no raw secrets)?

anya: Masked grep output:
```
VAULT_TOKEN=***redacted-vault-token***
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/ci-sa.json
{"type":"service_account","project_id":"redwood-ci","private_key_id":"***","private_key":"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n***\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"}
```

zach: Triage playbook proposal: 1) Revoke Vault token accessor and any issued leases. 2) Delete exposed SA key, create a new short-lived key with minimal roles. 3) Rewrap any KMS-wrapped artifacts and rotate transit keys if used. 4) Narrow IAM for ci-runner SA to the cache bucket only, remove storage.admin. 5) Tighten bucket ACLs, set lifecycle to 24h, enable object ACL uniform access. 6) Turn on Vault audit JSON sink + GCP object access logs for 7d.

ops-oncall: Running containment now. Commands executed (masked):
```
vault token-revoke -accessor "***accessor***"
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=ci-runner@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-ci
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-ci-key.json --iam-account=ci-runner@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-ci
```

ops-oncall: New key created and stored in Vault at secret/ci/runner/new-key with 1h lease. Old key deleted. Bucket IAM patched to remove broad roles and lifecycle set to 24h.

priya: Running audit queries now. Quick findings: Vault audit shows token-lookup + one KV read at secret/data/sandbox/api-keys (non-prod). GCP logs show the SA used to upload the cache at 2026-09-12T11:07Z. KMS decrypt occurred once at upload time. No reads under secret/data/prod-*.

zach: Good. Still run a rewrap job for artifacts encrypted by transit-KMS-14; schedule transit key rotation next maintenance window. I'll open a PR to constrain ci-runner IAM and add an allowlist for buckets.

anya: Action items and owners: revoke/delete SA key & token (ops-oncall) 1 done, new scoped key in Vault (ops-oncall) 1 done, RBAC scoping PR (zach) 1 in PR, rewrap/rotate transit key (zach) 1 queued, enable audit sinks (priya) 1 in progress.

priya: Post-incident: no prod exposure detected. Scheduling a 30-minute blameless review tomorrow 10:30 PT to discuss why build-cache included credentials and to require pre-upload scrubbing in the CI agent.

anya: Thanks everyone. Updating INC-2026-912 with timeline and owners, will close after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
